const readDownloadSessionControl = `-- name: ReadDownloadSessionControl :one
SELECT effective.id, effective.root_id, effective.audit_store_id, effective.response_limit, effective.window_limit, effective.audit_byte_limit, effective.reserved_responses, effective.reserved_windows, effective.reserved_audit_bytes, effective.valid_until, effective.audit_write_until FROM artifact_download s
JOIN download_control_allocation c ON c.id=s.allocation_id AND c.root_id=s.root_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL capacity_session_control(s,c) effective
WHERE s.id=$1 AND s.root_id=$2
`

type ReadDownloadSessionControlParams struct {
	ID     pgtype.UUID
	RootID pgtype.UUID
}
